summary: COBOL: Choose a message. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: IF checks a rule. END-IF marks where its branches finish. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.
